card.name: Citation details after Web-related titles
card.fires_on: Punctuation, years and small words inside academic citations and book references, especially after titles with Web, Hypermedia or Multimedia. It fires on the comma after page numbers, the 9 in 1990s years, and words like for and in inside a publisher name.

modes.label: Citation punctuation and years
modes.description: The comma after page numbers or a digit inside a 1990s year in a reference.
modes.example: 2008: World Conference on Educational Multimedia, Hypermedia and Telecommunications (pp. 5100-5107<<),>> Association for the Advancement of Computing in

modes.description: Small linking words within a conference or association name in a reference list.

card.writes: It promotes odd name-like pieces and suppresses network and Web words, so it pushes away from continuing with network terms.
card.plain: It marks the small details inside reference citations, such as years, page-number commas and publisher names.
